text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, check it out, there was a side trail 
over there. 
Let's check it out, No Reason, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
......Pray tell, how did we arrive at the 
decision 
to accompany Ste-Go-san on her stroll?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is Operation: Know Thy Enemy and Know 
No Defeat!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No matter how often I seek a match, she 
dodges me... 
Therefore, I figured I must first gain 
a thorough understanding of Lady Ste-Go's 
nature!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thou art on amicable terms with Lady 
Ste-Go. 
I summoned thee in hopes that thou wouldst 
possess a profound comprehension of her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, we do occasionally partake in tea 
together... 
Very well, I shall accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hup... 
Oh, found some saxifrage. Been a while 
since I had some of that.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Didst thou not claim this was a mere 
stroll...?!' 
This is practically mountaineering!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What Ste-Go-san refers to as a "stroll" is 
akin to a journey--- 
one cannot necessarily expect a gentle 
path...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No need to push yourselves~. If you head 
straight down that slope, you'll make it 
back to town.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh...! As if such a trifle could break 
me! 
I shall see this stroll of thine through 
to the bitter end! 
A warrior must always be true to their 
word!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... 
Well, suit yourself.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The sun hath fully set already--- 
And where in the world are weee---?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Huh, didn't know a peaceful spot like this 
existed. 
Oh, look, the riverbank's right there.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
---Yeah, great spot. 
Let's camp here tonight.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Camping in the middle of a stroll?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is a journey without itinerary, after 
all... 
As she pursues whatever strikes her fancy 
in the moment, 
such occurrences are only to be expected.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh... I see how it is... 
Well, camping and fishing appear permitted 
here... 
Then I have no choice but to give it my 
all!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nuoooohh!! 
Rainbow trout, acquired!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, quite a haul! Quite a haul! 
That's gonna make a fine dinner.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Leave hearth duty to me! 
I am well versed in striking flint! 
For it is a quintessential scene in 
historical period dramas!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, not bad at all! 
I'm done prepping the trout too, 
let's eat, let's eat!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Whew~... Stuffed, totally stuffed.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Still, No Reason, you're pretty handy. 
Good at catching fish bare-handed, and 
good with fire too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
---Oho? 
What's with that bluish butterfly over 
there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Chasing after butterflies... 
...She truly remains a child at heart, no 
matter how much time passes.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Entirely bound by nothing, 
drifting free as the clouds.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My. You seem surprisingly satisfied, 
even though you spoke of how 
Ste-Go-san is impossible to pin down.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nay, I already knew that much. 
I simply wished to experience her spirited 
nature 
up close once more with mine own eyes.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
---With a temperament that erratic, 
if I simply lie in wait, the day will 
surely come 
when the wind blows her back toward me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed, perhaps so---

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~... What a lovely morning. 
A lively walk isn't so bad once in a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
---Alright, guess it's time to head back! 
And then, let's have that match!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed, head back and have a ma---...Eh?

Early one weekend morning. 
Having dropped by the academy for some 
errands, 
I spot students running on the track.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: NUOOOOOOOOHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
---Haha, great stride, No Reason! 
Come on, we're not done yet!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
---Yeah. That was a great session. 
I had fun, No Reason.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*, *gasp*... W-What in blazes...!! 
Even for a shift in the wind, isn't that 
far too sudden?!

Is this about how she was plotting all 
sorts of schemes 
to get a match with Stay Gold earlier? 
Looks like she managed to run together in 
the end.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense, she is no toddler... 
Nay, could that truly be possible...? 
Curses, exhaustion clouds my wits...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I hardly believe it was in vain. 
At least as far as this stroll was 
concerned.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, yeah, totally. 
The stroll was a blast---No Reason.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. 
You put on quite the marvelous show 
during our camp, No Reason-san.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The rainbow trout catch?! 
Did *that* truly strike a chord with Lady 
Ste-Go?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. 
If I get to eat delicious trout again, 
the mood might strike me.
